title: Beat Bash Bonanza
subtitle: An original browser rhythm-party series, built to a Nintendo first-party bar
note: Foundation landed. Engine contracts + automated critic harness are live; every piece below is built by a dedicated agent and judged by a separate, harsher one that inspects the running game.

pieces.name: Audio-time clock & transport
pieces.detail: All time in the AudioContext domain, latency-compensated, smoothed DOM-event bridge.

pieces.name: Input & judgement
pieces.detail: Abstract actions with true press timestamps; ms windows; nearest-note claiming.

pieces.name: Critic harness
pieces.detail: Headless Chromium boots the built game, plays it at exact audio times, dumps frames + telemetry.

pieces.name: Audio engine & original music
pieces.detail: Synthesised score, adaptive layers, SFX kit. No files, no fetches.

pieces.name: Art direction & render
pieces.detail: Toon/gradient look, lighting, post, palette system.

pieces.name: VFX & juice
pieces.detail: Impact, trails, confetti, screen effects — pooled, zero per-frame allocation.

pieces.name: UI, HUD & typography
pieces.detail: HUD, verdict popups, transitions, rules cards.

pieces.name: Shell & party flow
pieces.detail: Title, select, results, party mode, save.

pieces.name: Swing Kings
pieces.detail: One swing. One beat. Send it.

pieces.name: Calibration & accessibility
pieces.detail: Latency calibration, reduced motion, colourblind-safe verdicts, one-button mode.

pieces.name: Coherence pass
pieces.detail: A fresh agent plays the whole game end to end and smooths it into one product.

pieces.name: Performance
pieces.detail: CPU budget, draw calls, no GC in hot paths.

log.msg: Foundation committed: clock, input, judge, feel, harness.
